channel.title: Historia Nomade Journal
channel.description: Field notes on positioning, websites and the small decisions that help a hospitality business become easier to choose.

item.title: Your hotel is not a commodity. Your website is making it one.
item.description: When every property describes itself as charming, central and welcoming, guests end up choosing on price. A better site gives them a reason to choose on fit.

item.title: The story should survive the booking page.
item.description: A thoughtful brand can disappear the moment a guest reaches a listing, a map result or a confirmation email. The full journey has to sound like the same place.

item.title: The first 30 seconds of a small hospitality website.
item.description: People do not need to know everything immediately. They need to know where they are, who the place is for and what makes it worth a closer look.
